formal_completion.scope: Every polynomial phase in every dimension over any commutative Q-algebra A
formal_completion.truncated_isomorphism: Phi_P:H_P/t^k H_P -> A[t]/t^k is an isomorphism for every k>=1,via multiplication by the invertible truncated exponential exp(tP)
formal_completion.unit_generator: The class1 maps to E exp(tP),a unit modulo t^k;the ordinary quotient has basis1 but its period need not be1
formal_completion.formal_Hom: Hom_Dt(H_P,A[[t]])=A Phi_P;normalization is evaluation on class1 at t0
formal_completion.actual_kernel: ker Phi_P=intersection_k t^k H_P,the largest submodule N with tN=N
formal_completion.boundary: Finite quotients are O-modules,not D_t quotients;the completion need not be faithful or preserve generic rank;t need not be injective on the kernel

polynomial_Hom_criterion.field_statement: Over a characteristic-zero field,dim Hom_Dt(H_P,K[t]) is0 or1 and P is mixed-safe exactly when it is1
polynomial_Hom_criterion.maximal_quotient: The maximal quotient that is a finite direct sum of polynomial modules is zero when unsafe and a single K[t] when safe
polynomial_Hom_criterion.algorithm: Compute the exact finite integration-source presentation,then a polynomial Hom basis;no actual-kernel or selected-period comparison is needed
polynomial_Hom_criterion.producer_boundary: The general integration and Hom solver remains unimplemented here;only finite t-adic primitives are implemented
polynomial_Hom_criterion.exactness_boundary: An arbitrary annihilating scalar presentation may have spurious polynomial quotients;D(D-1) annihilates exp(t) and also admits1
polynomial_Hom_criterion.coefficient_ring_statement: Polynomial Hom embeds in A with normalization ideal J_P={a:a Phi_P(H_P) subset A[t]};safety requires1 in J_P
polynomial_Hom_criterion.linear_family: For P=aX,H=A[t]e with e prime=a^2 t e,and J_P=union_N Ann_A(a^N);over Q[a,b]/ab this is(b),nonzero without safety

global_quotient_obstructions.relative_basechange_failure: For the genuine centered linear Gaussian family over Q[a],relative polynomial Hom iszero but its a0 fiber has dimension1;the two obvious strata remain valid
global_quotient_obstructions.joint_Fourier_failure: With a free constant phase coefficient c0,the largest joint quotient of the partial Fourier source supported on y0 iszero in all dimensions/degrees,despite safe coefficient fibers
global_quotient_obstructions.proof: For every c0-independent amplitude,B=partial_c0+partial_y annihilates its class and [B,y]=1;local nilpotence of y descends to kill the class
global_quotient_obstructions.normalization: Eliminating c0 by E(P)=0 removes that free translation but does not solve the centered relative base-change failure

indicial_source_scope.use: An indicial certificate plus adapted resolution,localization and valid integer-root cutoffs may replace a scalar b-function in a local restriction calculation
indicial_source_scope.parameter_boundary: D[y] and D3[beta] in the parameter examples are central extensions,not supplied differential equations in those parameters
indicial_source_scope.explicit_root_obstruction: At p=(1,2,1),Example12 has b=s(s-beta1-1/2);beta1=N-1/2 gives roots0,N on one degree-two stratum
indicial_source_scope.missing: No finite Gaussian indicial/Hom chart cover,actual-image comparison under general specialization or arbitrary-irregular uniformity theorem is imported
